titulo_es: Recognize passive and causative in notices

하지 마세요.en: Don't do it, don't let it

아이에게 혼자 문을 열게 하지.es: Fragmento de la frase: No deje que el niño abra la puerta solo.
아이에게 혼자 문을 열게 하지.en: Fragment of the phrase: Do not let the child open the door alone.

사용 후에는 문을 닫아 주세요.es: Después de usarla, cierre la puerta, por favor
사용 후에는 문을 닫아 주세요.en: After using it, close the door, please.

texto: It is a state that has been described; it is a state that has been called for action. Root and termination help to distinguish who acts and who receives the action.
the door is open. Close the door, please.
